thread:
Sara B: Proposal — run a dual-window go/no-go for the 3.2.1 cut to reduce rollover risk. Primary window: Tue 2026-05-12 16:00 UTC. Fallback window: Wed 2026-05-13 00:00 UTC. Asking owners to RSVP + required stakeholders.
James L: +1. Can we make the primary window shorter (45m) and keep a 2h fallback?
Sara B: Yep, plan is 45m active cut window + 30m immediate smoke, then we keep fallback for any rollbacks or extended validations.
Oliver K: Who's owning the canary smoke? I can take the runtime checks and latency baseline.
Maya P: I can do post-cut integration checks (APIs + onboarding flow). Lina will run QA regression suite in parallel.
Lina (QA): FYI some long regressions need infra warmups — will queue quick-smoke first then full-suite in fallback window.
devops-bot: Reminder: scheduled maintenance pre-check at 15:15 UTC (45m before primary).
James L: Quick ask — please add the stakeholder list (SRE, infra, product security, release PM) so they know to be on call.
Sara B: Added stakeholders: @James L (release lead), @Oliver K (runtime), @Maya P (integration), @Lina (QA), @Ken (SRE), @Anya (Security), @ProductOps.
Sara B: Agenda draft (short):
```
1) Rollcall and go/no-go criteria (5m)
2) Preconditions status: infra, canary image, DB migrations (10m)
3) Cut steps and owner walk-through (10m)
4) Canary smoke results (15m)
5) Rollback criteria & fallback plan activation (5m)
6) Post-cut validation and metrics check (10m)
```
Sara B: Please comment on the criteria section — I've put the bar at: <1% 5xx increase, p95 latency <= baseline + 20ms, no data-loss alerts.
Maya P: That sounds reasonable. Suggest adding a check for async-worker queue depth drop < 10% of baseline after cut.
Oliver K: Agree on queue depth. Also add a quick KV-cache hit-rate sanity check (we saw regressions last month).
James L: Logistics: who will be in the war-room channel? I propose SRE, runtime, QA, release lead, and product on-call. Keep it tight.
Sara B: War-room list: @Ken (SRE), @Oliver K, @Lina, @James L, @Anya, @Maya P. Others on standby.
Lina (QA): RSVP: primary window = available. Fallback = available but on-call rotation changes at 23:45 UTC, might be Lina -> Alex.
Maya P: RSVP: primary yes, fallback conditional (depends on customer demos on Wed morning).
Oliver K: RSVP: both windows confirmed. I'll bring the latency dashboards and traces.
James L: Small ops ask — can we prepare a single-line rollback command and post it in the runbook? Example:
```
# rollback to previous deploy
./deploy --target release-3.2.0 --force-rollback
```
Sara B: Good call. I'll add rollback commands + required post-rollback validation checklist to the runbook.
Sara B: One more: can owners please post last_message_ts when you finish pre-checks. I'll collect and update the board.
devops-bot: Poll: React :thumbsup: if you can attend primary window; :eyes: if fallback only.
James L: :thumbsup:
Oliver K: :thumbsup:
Maya P: :thumbsup: (primary tentative)
Lina (QA): :thumbsup:
Sara B: Thanks — I'll finalize invite and runbook by EOD. If any blockers surface ping me directly.
James L: Noted. Can someone add a short one-pager for product stakeholders describing rollback impact? They usually ask during go/no-go.
Maya P: I'll draft the one-pager and drop in the release folder.
Sara B: Perfect. Closing notes: primary 16:00 UTC — join the #release-war-room link once the pre-check bot confirms. Fallback at 00:00 UTC if needed. Thanks all. :rocket:
